title: TFC Kaolinite (Almost) Everywhere!
description: Modifies TerraFirmaCraft's kaolinite generation rules to allow it to spawn in any temperature as long as the average rainfall is higher than 100mm :D
body:
Ever wanted to have a frozen wasteland world in TFC but wondered about the logistics of obtaining kaolinite? Well that's the very predicament I found myself in roughly 2 hours ago... So I made this datapack :D

## Features:
- Kaolinite now spawns in it's usual biomes but with a much more lenient climate range: over 100mm of annual rainfall and above -20ºC average temperature, so essentially anywhere but in a desert.

Have fun!
